tests.name: Tier 1: Public Sanity Checks (Known Vectors)
tests.setup: python3 firmware/tests/data/scripts/public_vectors.py && gcc -std=c11 firmware/src/doa_engine.c firmware/tests/test_doa.c firmware/tests/data/public_vectors.c -I firmware/include -I firmware/tests/data -o test_public -lm

tests.name: Tier 2: Hidden Stress Test (Randomized & Noisy)
tests.setup: python3 firmware/tests/data/scripts/public_vectors.py --randomize && gcc -std=c11 firmware/src/doa_engine.c firmware/tests/test_doa.c firmware/tests/data/public_vectors.c -I firmware/include -I firmware/tests/data -o test_secret -lm
